verticalFaqs.question: Does Duet handle different lesson types and equipment rentals?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet learns all your offerings — private lessons, group lessons, kids camps, board rentals, SUP tours. When an inquiry comes in, it drafts a reply with the correct pricing, duration, what's included, and what to bring. It knows a school group email needs different details than a private lesson booking.

verticalFaqs.question: What about weather and conditions questions?
verticalFaqs.answer: Duet learns how you typically handle conditions emails — your policies on cancellations, rescheduling, and what conditions you teach in. When someone emails asking if their lesson will go ahead, Duet drafts a reply matching your usual tone and policy. You review and send in seconds.
